Error at Voltage Transducer.
They output analog Voltage 0..10V, although they start with the output of
2V
when measuring 0V (thats an analog integer value of ~5500 in the PLC). If this value is lower than 3000, the error is being set.
0 V indicates an error, used for broken wire detection.
true
: Transducer analog output is lower than 2V (3000 counts integer)
TF1-5: Short circuit between GND2 and 10V

additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Please be informed that there is an intermittent error on the charger related to the Voltage Transducer (TF5). The error is not constant—it appears and disappears—which may indicate a loose connection or an unstable input.
Kindly perform the following checks:
Verify the input supply to TF5 and ensure it is stable.
Inspect all wiring connections to TF5 for any signs of looseness or displacement.
Check and test the control side of TF5 connectors for proper functionality.
Look for any terminal displacement or irregularities in the connector seating.
Please carry a spare TF5 with you during the visit in case replacement is necessary.
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA5 -TF1, -TF2, -TF3, -TF4, -TF5 Voltage Transducer 1500VDC / 10VDC
